fluff.overview: After the Jihad stripped many elite units to fill battle armor companies, the LCAF recognized that conventional infantry remained essential for roles that battle armor could not cost-effectively fill. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Armed with assault rifles and Grand Mauler infantry gauss cannons, these platoons field some of the hardest-hitting crew-served weapons available to conventional infantry, capable of threatening armored vehicles at extended range.
